A man sold the Eiffel Tower,
and the buyer never called the police.
and Paris was openly talking about tearing it down.
So Victor Lustig printed fake government letterhead,
and invited five scrap dealers to a secret meeting.

he was an underpaid official, and he’d need a little bribe.
Because only a real official would ask for a bribe.
and Lustig was on a train out of Paris with a suitcase of cash.

Poisson was too embarrassed to admit he’d been fooled.
